question: Do sparse/manual chamber measurements bias Arctic-boreal monthly or annual methane flux estimates relative to continuous eddy-covariance observations after ecosystem-by-month representation is corrected?

synthetic_calibration.result: between-stratum reweighting can remove class/time imbalance but cannot repair within-stratum preferential measurement-day sampling

prior_art.reason: Already compares coincident chamber and eddy-covariance CH4 across ten sites from half-hourly through annual scales and analyzes spatial heterogeneity, chamber placement/footprints, protocol and environmental drivers.

stop_reason: The sharpened empirical discriminator is already published; continuing with new ABCFlux data would be rediscovery rather than a fresh scientific contribution.
holdout_note: No ABCFlux methane flux outcomes were opened; there is no confirmation evidence to spend because the candidate was rejected on prior art.
